Name: Jehoram, Son of Ahab
Summary: Jehoram, son of Ahab and king of Israel, also called Joram, was wounded by the Syrians at Ramoth-gilead and was later slain when Jehu, anointed to cut off the house of Ahab, came against him.
KeyStory: Ahaziah went down to see Jehoram son of Ahab at Jezreel because he was sick, and his coming to Joram became the occasion of his destruction by Jehu.
RelatedPeople: King Ahab; Ahaziah, King of Judah; Jehu, Son of Nimshi
LifeLesson: Friendship with an idolatrous house can drag a king to his death.
